message:
## Vulnerability Digest

One newly published vulnerability directly matches the monitored product families, and five additional WordPress plugin issues may be relevant if those plugins are installed.

**Scope:** `Products.txt` and `List_of_SIA_Completed.txt` only. Entries were normalized and deduplicated; `DLL_software_component.txt` was not read or combined.

**Scan window:** 2026-11-01 05:10 IST through 2026-11-02 05:10 IST (2026-10-31 23:40 UTC through 2026-11-01 23:40 UTC).

### Finding 1 — Microsoft Visual Studio certificate-validation vulnerability

- **Product:** Microsoft Visual Studio
- **Issue:** [CVE-2026-118147](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-118147)
- **Severity:** High, CVSS 7.4 (Microsoft)
- **Description:** Improper certificate validation can allow an unauthenticated network attacker to perform spoofing. The published record identifies affected Visual Studio 2017 15.9 builds before 15.9.84, 2019 16.11 builds before 16.11.62, 2022 17.14 builds before 17.14.44, and 2026 18.11 builds before 18.11.3.
- **Why relevant:** Visual Studio is explicitly monitored. The inventory does not establish whether an affected release is deployed, so version confirmation is required.
- **Freshness:** The CVE record was published on 2026-10-31 at 18:13 UTC, inside this scan window.
- **Source:** [Microsoft Security Response Center](https://msrc.microsoft.com/update-guide/vulnerability/CVE-2026-118147); publication metadata corroborated by the [CVE record mirror](https://app.opencve.io/cve/CVE-2026-118147).

### Possible matches needing review — WordPress plugins

These issues affect WordPress plugins, not WordPress core. They are relevant only if the named plugins are installed; none appears in the supplied inventory.

- **MapPress Maps for WordPress — CVE-2026-118168:** CVSS 5.3; unauthenticated email-address disclosure in versions before 2.97.15.
- **Media Library Assistant — CVE-2026-113482 and CVE-2026-113481:** CVSS 6.5 stored XSS and CVSS 4.3 missing authorization in versions before 3.44.
- **Kali Forms — CVE-2026-107343 and CVE-2026-107342:** CVSS 4.3 email-sending/sender-spoofing and CVSS 4.3 user-email disclosure in versions before 2.4.30.
- **Source:** [Patchstack WordPress vulnerability database](https://patchstack.com/database/). These entries were published on 2026-11-01.

### MongoDB ecosystem verification

The dedicated sweep covered MongoDB Server Community and Enterprise, `mongod`, `mongos`, Atlas and Atlas services, Ops Manager, Cloud Manager, Compass, `mongosh`, Database Tools, Kubernetes Operator, official drivers and major libraries, connectors, BI Connector, Charts, Realm/App Services, official integrations, MongoDB-owned notices, CVE/NVD-linked records, GitHub Security Advisories, and CISA sources. [MongoDB's security alert catalog](https://www.mongodb.com/resources/products/alerts) showed no MongoDB-family advisory published in this scan window; the newest visible vendor entries were dated October 13, 2026.

### Review priority

Promptly verify deployed Visual Studio versions against CVE-2026-118147. Also check WordPress plugin inventory for MapPress, Media Library Assistant, and Kali Forms; the plugin findings do not affect WordPress core by themselves.
